# v29 Part G: application traces that load the network (descriptive, no test; generated by report_v29.py)

The Netrace runs of round 25 load the network with less than a tenth of the saturation load. Here the protocol of those runs (2x2, pipe_all 2, one application: the
first 700,000 cycles of region 2 of each of the nine PARSEC traces, dependency mode, 2- and 18-flit packets) is run with `-netrace_compress S`, which divides the
time stamps of the trace by S. Per trace S is the smallest value in {2, 4, 8, 16, 32} at which the mean latency of DeFT_P (seed 41) is at least 1.5 times its
latency at S = 1 (`trace_compress.md`); at that S DeFT_P, MTR, RC and the main row are run on seeds 41-43. Runs in `trace_runs.csv`: 65; runs that did not deliver
their whole window or had a dead-end event: 0. *Offered*: received flits per node and cycle up to the completion of the window, a mean over a bursty trace; for
scale, DeFT_P saturates under uniform traffic at 8 x Lsat = 0.104 flits/node/cycle (`load_points_v25.json`).
